notes: Implementation task, no register proposals (absorption-spec §13 task 5). Three changes in src/managent/main.zig, plus two regression scripts, all test-first per the bars. (1) CLOSED PARTITION: new computeAbsorptionPartition() joins claimlint's `c7 --json` per-file report (path/task_id/conforming/unabsorbed — claimlint's own count, the T294 rule) against the live kanban + archive, which only managent knows. A file is in the CLOSED partition when it is non-conforming or carries unabsorbed proposals AND its owning task is done/failed/archived (declared task_id, else the filename-derived id so a misnamed orphan surfaces, absorption-spec §12). Everything else with drift is the OPEN partition — healthy in-flight work, surfaced informationally only. cmdAudit emits each closed-partition file as a FIX finding naming the file ('closed-partition drift: <path> carries N unabsorbed proposal(s) on closed task <id> — mechanism bypass'), and prints an informational 'absorption partition: closed N, open N file(s) / N unabsorbed proposal(s)' line (human mode; --json gets findings only). (2) STANDING-ABSORB RE-POINT: the trigger is now closed-partition > 0 (a crisis signal for mechanism bypass), replacing the retired ABSORB_C7_THRESHOLD = 5 (constant + its rationale block deleted). cmdStanding no longer scrapes claimlint's human-readable C7 summary/detail lines; it consumes c7 --json. A blind partition (claimlint spawn/parse/exit-3 failure) is a loud FATAL at the marker guard, never a silent 0 (T368 class). (3) RE-FIRE FIX: already landed via T406's registerStanding reopen path (done/failed standing row -> dispatchable on trigger); this task re-verifies it against the NEW trigger and keeps the seeded-reopen control green. CONTROLS (test-first, scratch store + fixture register per T427): regression-managent-standing.sh re-pointed — null (empty findings -> 'closed partition: 0 ... closed partition is empty, no trigger'), seeded (a DONE task carrying 6 unabsorbed claims -> closed partition 1, TRIGGERED, file named in per-file composition), marker guard (drifted claimlint format -> RC=1 + UNRELIABLE + FATAL; C7 summary/detail markers dropped from the guard because C7 is now consumed via c7 --json, whose contract regression-claimlint-c7-json.sh guards). regression-absorption-machinery.sh re-pointed — C1 seeded reopen (done STANDING-ABSORB + closed partition 1 -> dispatchable, note updated), C2 live guard (in_progress -> NOT re-registered, refusal reads as inaction), C4 null (closed partition 0 -> store untouched), and NEW section E: E1 audit names a closed-partition file as FIX (RC=1), E2 audit silent once the drift is removed. RED-then-GREEN: the re-pointed assertions were written against the old binary first (they fail — the old output says 'C7 unabsorbed: ... (threshold 5)'), then pass against the rebuilt zig-out binary. Blast radius audited: the four wired scripts that run `managent audit` in scratch repos (claim-lifecycle, directive-integrity, duplicate-dispatch, integrity) already carry the T485 provision (claimlint copy + header-only register), so the audit's internal c7 --json run exits 0 there and the partition adds no findings — all four re-verified ALL PASS.
